items.html: And indeed it did not descend there because of a blemish in it, for it was already explained above that the breaking was in the vessels, not in the lights, and had its descent there been because of a blemish, it would have been proper to attribute nullification to the lights, the way we attributed nullification to the vessels of the posteriors of AVI that fell in their like in Atzilut itself. But its descent was in order to illuminate from afar into its own vessel standing in Beria, so that it would not die completely and remain without hope; therefore it illuminates in it from afar while it itself stands in Atzilut, and it is in the phase of crowns on the letters, as was said above.
